content.text: {"rows":[{"source_id":"id07431","target":"Затем, подойдя к опущенной шторке, он сказал:"},{"source_id":"id07432","target":"— Приятного вам времяпрепровождения, монсеньор! — сказал он."},{"source_id":"id07433","target":"— Болтун! — крикнул д’Артаньян. — Из-за вас меня выгонят."},{"source_id":"id07434","target":"Шлагбаум заскрипел на петлях; д’Артаньян, увидев, что путь свободен, энергично хлестнул лошадей, и те крупной рысью понеслись вперёд."},{"source_id":"id07435","target":"Через пять минут они догнали карету кардинала."},{"source_id":"id07436","target":"— Мушкетон, — крикнул д’Артаньян, — поднимите шторки на карете Его Величества."},{"source_id":"id07437","target":"— Это он, — сказал Портос."},{"source_id":"id07438","target":"— В кучерах! — воскликнул Мазарини."},{"source_id":"id07439","target":"— Да ещё с каретой коадъютора! — сказала королева."},{"source_id":"id07440","target":"— Corpo di Dio! Монсу д’Артаньян, — сказал Мазарини, — вы стоите своего веса в золоте!"}],"review":[{"source_id":"id07431","verdict":"PASS","reason":"Faithful. The added «он сказал» is a natural Russian lead-in to the colon and changes no fact or agency; the lowered mantelet is rendered correctly."},{"source_id":"id07432","verdict":"PASS","reason":"The prior fix of the garbled «монseigneur» to «монсеньор» is verified. The ironic well-wishing «Bien du plaisir» is idiomatic and the dialogue punctuation is correct."},{"source_id":"id07433","verdict":"PASS","reason":"Meaning, exclamation and the threat «vous me ferez chasser» («меня выгонят») are preserved. «Болтун» is an acceptable rendering of «Indiscret» in this context."},{"source_id":"id07434","verdict":"CORRECTED","reason":"The adverb «vigoureusement» was omitted. Restored as «энергично хлестнул». The rest (the barrier creaking on its hinges, the road open, the horses at a full trot) was already accurate."},{"source_id":"id07435","verdict":"PASS","reason":"Time span, the pluperfect sense of «on avait rejoint» and the cardinal's carriage are accurate."},{"source_id":"id07436","verdict":"PASS","reason":"The order to Mousqueton to raise the mantelets of His Majesty's carriage is preserved, with correct interrupted-dialogue punctuation."},{"source_id":"id07437","verdict":"PASS","reason":"Accurate and complete."},{"source_id":"id07438","verdict":"PASS","reason":"«En cocher!» is rendered as «В кучерах!», with the exclamation and attribution to Mazarin preserved."},{"source_id":"id07439","verdict":"PASS","reason":"The prior fix is verified: «avec le carrosse du coadjuteur» is rendered as «с каретой коадъютора», not «в карете»."},{"source_id":"id07440","verdict":"PASS","reason":"The prior fix is verified: «Monsou» is transliterated as «Монсу» in italics, matching Mazarin's Italianate speech, and «Corpo di Dio!» stays in italics. «Vous valez votre pesant d'or» is idiomatic."}]}
